what_it_is: A MiSTer Saturn core save (internal backup RAM, 64 KiB byte-expanded with 0x00) holding RALLYPLUS_0. The high (even) bytes of the first 0x40 bytes hold semi-random garbage; the core's author (srg320) replied that the high byte is ignored and reads as 0xFF on hardware.
note: The same file is attached to the issue as 'Sega.Rally.Championship.Plus.Japan.sav.zip' (https://github.com/user-attachments/files/17938443/Sega.Rally.Championship.Plus.Japan.sav.zip); fetched here from the converter's test data, where it is used as 'MISTER_INTERNAL_ONLY_WITH_GARBAGE'.
